up: List all approved drugs (molecules with max_phase = 4) whose mechanism of action is classified as a sequestering agent (drug_mechanism.action_type = 'SEQUESTERING AGENT'). Include the compound details (compound name and ChEMBL ID from molecule_dictionary) and the target details (target name and ChEMBL ID from target_dictionary) for each drug-target pair. Also include the action_type from drug_mechanism to confirm. Join drug_mechanism.molregno to molecule_dictionary.molregno and drug_mechanism.tid to target_dictionary.tid. Return one row per drug-target combination.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.pref_name AS compound_name, md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, dm.action_type FROM drug_mechanism dm JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid WHERE dm.action_type = 'SEQUESTERING AGENT' AND md.max_phase = 4;
